title: Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy
bio: Grant is an Adjunct Lecturer at Harvard Kennedy school, and Adjunct Professor at the Tuck School of Business at Dartmouth where he teaches a course on Transforming Public Interest Organizations. He is currently developing a new course on lessons on careers and life.
